en.title: Phoenix Airport Teams with ReBokeh to Boost Traveler Accessibility Features
en.summary: Phoenix Airport has partnered with ReBokeh to enhance accessibility features and services for travelers with disabilities. Meanwhile, the ELCA Learning Day highlighted inclusion through workshops, and Rachel Shaw shared practical steps for workplace accessibility. A review of The 7th Guest remake praised its modern accessibility options alongside classic horror gameplay.

zh-TW.title: 鳳凰機場ReBokeh合作無障礙
zh-TW.summary: 鳳凰機場已與ReBokeh合作，提升對殘障旅客的無障礙設施與服務。ELCA學習日則透過工作坊強調包容與無障礙，Rachel Shaw分享職場無障礙的實際步驟。《第七位來客》重製版獲得好評，因其兼具經典恐怖玩法與現代無障礙選項。
